manaNeeded: {7}{U}{U} each turn plus {5} each turn beyond the first
description:
Cast Expropriate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Expropriate and up to six other exiled cards, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library. Ensure Expropriate is the top card of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Expropriate from your library during your draw step.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mirror of Fate from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Mirror of Fate from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.
